intro: James is practical wisdom for everyday faith. Tradition holds that it was written by James, the brother of Jesus.
In five short chapters, it covers trials, wealth, words, and prayer, and insists that real faith shows itself in what we do.
Listen for: be ye doers of the word, and not hearers only.

card.key: Count it all joy (1) · Faith without works (2) · Taming the tongue (3) · Draw nigh to God (4)
